BiblicalUsage: The word is Aramaic for the earth, and it appears once, in the one Aramaic verse in Jeremiah: the gods that have not made the heavens and the earth shall perish from the earth and from under these heavens.
TheologicalSignificance: A single Aramaic sentence in the middle of Jeremiah is enough to doom every false god.
